Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of CRM.
Our gross margin expanded by 107 basis points to 62.0%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2019.
Operating income reached $12.3 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Revenue guidance of $41.1 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. Our cloud segment grew 23% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Second question - Analyst:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 107 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
